snippet.title: Madeline and the Magnificent Puppet Show: A Learning Journey (1995) - Demo
snippet.description:
A demo of the game "Madeline and the Magnificent Puppet Show: A Learning Journey" for parents.

Madeline and the Magnificent Puppet Show: A Learning Journey, was the first entry in the Madeline  series. Its release was scheduled to promote the ABC TV animated television series The New Adventures of Madeline. Set in Paris, France, it follows Madeline as she organizes a puppet show to raise money to help her neighbor Mr. Benet avoid eviction by his greedy landlord.

Review by The Free Lance-Star - Oct 21, 1995: https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1298&dat=19951021&id=F-oyAAAAIBAJ&sjid=1AcGAAAAIBAJ&pg=2121,4134392   

Website: https://www.nostalgiarealm.com
